s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with cardiac arrhythmia
salient_findings: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
ECG findings: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with cardiac arrhythmia
salient_findings: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
ECG findings: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia

differentials: Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response
per_call: Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response

shortlist.label: Atrial tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings of regular, narrow complex tachycardia

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings and long RP interval

shortlist.label: Orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings and presence of P waves

shortlist.label: COVID-19 pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: Positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test and respiratory symptoms

shortlist.label: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Palpitations and ECG findings of regular, narrow complex tachycardia

raw.rationale: The ECG findings of regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a long RP interval and superiorly directed P waves are consistent with atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT). The patient's presentation with palpitations and the absence of prior arrhythmia history also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Atrial tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG findings do not show evidence of atrial enlargement or abnormal P-wave morphology typical of atrial tachycardia.

rejected.label: Orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG findings do not show evidence of pre-excitation or an accessory pathway, which is characteristic of orthodromic AVRT.

rejected.label: COVID-19 pneumonia
rejected.why: While the patient is COVID-19 positive, the primary complaint of palpitations and the ECG findings suggest a cardiac arrhythmia rather than a pulmonary issue as the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
rejected.why: This is a broad term that encompasses several types of supraventricular tachycardias, including AVNRT. The specific ECG findings in this case are more consistent with AVNRT than a general diagnosis of PSVT.
